metadata.name: Frost Basin
metadata.author: ChronoSplit
metadata.description: A wide snowy basin ringed by mountains. Embers hold the southern hilltop hall, Tide the northern one: each has a railed roof with turrets and a sniper rifle, a buggy, a speeder and a hauler, and a cliff out front that only jump pads climb. Two rocky ridges cross the field with a pass in the middle; the three-storey outpost at the centre hides the railgun on its roof, with rockets out on the east flank and double damage on the west. An homage in spirit to the great outdoor team maps of the early 2000s.
